story:
Morris Kitchens has been in business since 1995, started by local proprietor John Morris. The original showroom was in Plymouth and moved to Hanover Township in 2008 — we are right next to Colarusso's Pizza & Pasta in the West End Plaza, so come for lunch and stay to shop for your new kitchen or bathroom.

In January of 2016 John decided it was time to retire and spend more time with his family, and Patrick Healey purchased the business. Pat graduated from Johnson College and had been a home builder in this area for almost thirty years. Even with a successful building business, he wanted a career that gave him more time with his family while still putting his creativity to work on kitchens, bathrooms, entertainment areas, and bar areas.

In October of 2016 Celeste Donnelly joined to design kitchens and baths and run the day-to-day of the office. Celeste is a graduate of Marywood University with a bachelor's of fine arts in interior design. She had design experience during and after college at another kitchen design center, then spent twelve years at a local tile store. No job is too small or too big — we want you to love your space.

Morris Kitchens & Donnelly Designs, LLC provides exceptional service to homeowners looking to update a kitchen and to business owners who want a bathroom that will impress clients. We have listened to plenty of people with out-of-the-ordinary ideas about how they wanted a room to look, and with us you are only limited by your imagination. Whether you are remodeling a kitchen, a bathroom, an office, or any other room, it pays to have experienced remodeling professionals beside you from start to finish.
